versions.description: Built-in shop actions for common use cases like granting roles, sending messages, giving an Item Set, and executing commands. The give-item action gives an Item Set, managed on the server's Item Sets page. Upgrading from 0.0.1 unlinks every shop listing that uses one of these actions; re-link each listing to this version's action afterwards.

shopActions.name: grantRole
shopActions.description: Grants a Takaro role to the player who made the purchase.

shopActions.name: sendMessage
shopActions.description: Sends an in-game message to the buyer or broadcasts to all players.

shopActions.name: giveItem
